title: Build datex from pure arithmetic, kill 18/20 calweeks mutants, extend, and pass the audit seal
goal: A four-stage month-scale campaign. Stage 1 implements a proleptic-Gregorian date library for years 1..9999 with the standard date modules banned in the implementation file (the grader scans import lines), pinned to sealed ordinal and weekday anchors. Stage 2 hardens the shipped ISO-week library calweeks by killing at least 18 of 20 sealed mutants - ISO week-53 and year-boundary rules make the last few survivors genuinely hard and demand survivor-by-survivor triage. Stage 3 adds recurrence helpers without regressing stage 1; stage 4 is an audit seal over a complete run journal, an honest cost record, and a 60-second total suite runtime budget. Everything - including the four-marker sha256 chain proving stage order - is scored as one campaign_score.
resources: pypi pytest==8.3.4 (installed by the sealed grader inside the container)
assets/gc-416/SPEC.md (API contract, import ban, artifact contract)
assets/gc-416/calweeks.py (sealed mutation target) + assets/gc-416/mutants/ (20 sealed mutants)
process_expectations: A frozen four-stage plan predates implementation and survives unmodified (sha256 chain across plan and four stage markers).
The implementation is genuinely arithmetic: the grader rejects datetime/calendar/time/zoneinfo/dateutil imports in work/gc-416/datex.py.
Mutation work shows survivor triage: runs.log has at least 8 honest entries across stages, with stage-2 entries reflecting climbing kill counts rather than one opaque attempt.
Recurrence features do not regress the core: the grader re-runs the stage-1 suite after stage 3.
The audit seal (stage4 marker) is only valid on top of a complete journal, an honest cost.json, and suites inside the runtime budget - process evidence is graded, not narrated.
